S1.name: generated:S1
S1.description:
Unverifiable action intake is recorded as rejected, never applied

risk: malformed_input (priority P1)
purpose: Drive the reachable delivery intake with a tampered token and prove the boundary durably RECORDS the unconfirmable outcome instead of treating it as success or dropping it — the persistence invariant the 'unconfirmed => unknown, never delivered' AC depends on.
requirement: a send whose outcome is unconfirmed is recorded as unknown, never as delivered
product principle: outcome_verification
rationale: An unverifiable input is the intake analog of an unconfirmable outcome; U-DEL-7 requires such outcomes be recorded (not applied, not silently swallowed), and this is the only slice of that invariant reachable without the signing secret.

S2.name: generated:S2
S2.description:
Missing token yields a recorded dead-end-free refusal, not a silent no-op

risk: missing_data (priority P2)
purpose: POST the intake with no token and confirm the server returns an explicit, actionable refusal rather than silently accepting or crashing.
requirement: a transport outage leaves no notification silently dropped
product principle: dead_end_error
rationale: A delivery request stripped of its identifying token is the degenerate 'nothing to deliver' case; the product must answer explicitly (no silent success), which is the observable half of 'nothing silently dropped'.

S3.name: generated:S3
S3.description:
Simultaneous identical retries are each recorded; none dropped, no crash

risk: concurrency (priority P1)
purpose: Fire two identical tampered submissions in parallel and confirm the intake answers both and durably records the attempts under concurrency, rather than losing one to a race or crashing.
requirement: a transport outage leaves no notification silently dropped
product principle: repository_silent
rationale: Retry storms and double-clicks are exactly when a delivery layer drops or double-processes; this proves the reachable intake neither drops an attempt nor 500s when two arrive at once.

S4.name: generated:S4
S4.description:
Recorded outcomes survive a callback restart (durability)

risk: restart_recovery (priority P2)
purpose: Record a rejected intake, restart the callback service, submit again, and confirm the persisted rejection record survives the restart and the store is still writable — the durability the 'nothing silently dropped' guarantee rests on.
requirement: U-DEL-7
product principle: failure_recovery
rationale: A resilience guarantee is only real if the record outlives a process bounce; if outcome records lived in memory or a lost handle, a restart between send and confirm would erase the evidence a notification was ever attempted.

generated at 2026-08-10T08:06:11+00:00 (stage=initial, wave 1)
because of risk: An outcome recorded before a restart could be lost (in-memory/unflushed), so post-restart the system cannot tell a notification was already attempted and re-drives or forgets it.
